test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A sum of money at simple interest doubles itself in 4 years 4 months. In how much time will it triple itself ?
solution:
**Given:**

A sum of money at simple interest doubles itself in 4 years 4 months.

**Formula used:**

Time to triple = 2 × (Time to double)

**Calculation:**

Time to double = 4 years 4 months

⇒ 4 years 4 months = 4 + 4/
